```yaml
name: Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y git-core curl wget unzip
        curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_14.x | sudo -E bash -
        sudo apt-get install -y nodejs
        npm install -g yarn
        yarn install

    - name: Fix broken test suite
      run: |
        # Add your fixes here
        echo "Fixing broken test suite..."

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        yarn test
```

Please note that this is a basic example of a GitHub Actions workflow for running tests on a pull request. You may need to adjust it based on your specific project requirements.
